stemMd: A ball rolls horizontally off a ledge in a vacuum in a uniform vertical gravitational field. What happens to its horizontal velocity before it hits the ground?

options.label: C
options.textMd: It equals its vertical velocity at every instant.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It increases because gravity acts horizontally.

explanationMd: With air resistance absent, the only force is vertical gravity. Horizontal acceleration is zero, so the horizontal velocity component remains unchanged.

distractorRationale.e: Gravity acts vertically in this model.
distractorRationale.c: The components follow different initial conditions.
